name: API endpoint
about: Add or extend a FastAPI endpoint with request/response models and tests.
title: Implement {feature} endpoint
description:
Implement the {method} /api/{resource} endpoint for {feature}.
Validate input with Pydantic models; return typed responses.
Handle 404/409 cases explicitly.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a valid request to {method} /api/{resource}
When the endpoint is called
Then it returns {success_status} with the expected payload
And invalid input returns 422
And a missing resource returns 404
And there is a passing pytest covering success and error paths
